text_block_list.text:
On the day of the Wakagoma Stakes,
a challenge taken with an eye toward the Classic races—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
A big, deep breath~...
Inhale... exhale... inhale... exhale...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "...Ah, did you think I was nervous by any chance?"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No, no! Just thinking about this being a prelude to the Classics
got me way too excited!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I need to stay properly calm
so I don't get overexcited and mess up!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, just watch me while eating some ice cream.
I'll be back in first place before you even finish it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'll go show everyone what the rising star,
Lord Teio, is truly capable of!
